Consonantal i

Theme

Latin word

adulēscentia

adulēscentia, adulēscentiae f.

noun, first declension

youth, the years between boyhood and manhood

In this lexicon

  • youth

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Sen. 70: vēr enim tamquam adulēscentiam significat; Tac. Agr. 4.2: pueritiam adulēscentiamque trānsēgit

Examples

  • vēr enim tamquam adulēscentiam significat ostenditque frūctūs futūrōs

    for spring stands for youth, as it were, and shows the fruit to comeCic. Sen. 70

    In the entry for youth

  • frūctuōsior est adulēscentia līberōrum, sed īnfantia dulcior

    children’s youth bears more fruit, but their infancy is sweeterSen. Ep. 9.7

    In the entry for youth

  • in hujus sinū indulgentiāque ēducātus per omnem honestārum artium cultum pueritiam adulēscentiamque trānsēgit

    brought up in her lap and her loving care, he spent his childhood and youth in the study of every honourable artTac. Agr. 4.2

    In the entry for youth
